ORG 0000H         ; Reset vector (program starts here)
MOV R0, #25H      ; Load first number (25H) into Register 0
MOV A, #34H       ; Load second number (34H) into Accumulator
ADD A, R0         ; Add content of R0 to Accumulator (A = A + R0)
MOV 30H, A        ; Store the final result in RAM address 30H
END               ; End of the program

;This program adds two 8-bit numbers stored in registers and 
;saves the result in internal RAM location 30H
